headline: Allegro lists power-IC verification roles covering startup checks, RNM models and reusable UVM methodology
fact: An employer-supplied Allegro MicroSystems recruiting job posting dated September 21 describes top-level AMS testbenches, Verilog-AMS/RNM/wreal models, and checks of power transitions, brownouts, POR, POK and UVLO over voltage and temperature corners. A related Richardson team-lead posting checked on October 5 assigns Power IC verification strategy, reusable SystemVerilog/UVM infrastructure, behavioral-model development, requirements-to-test traceability, safety checks and exploration of AI automation. Both are public hiring mandates.
